ruleDefinitions.name: File Download Using ProtocolHandler.exe
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of "ProtocolHandler" to download files. Downloaded files will be located in the cache folder (for example - %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\INetCache\IE)

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\protocolhandler\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "ProtocolHandler\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*ftp\\:\\/\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*http\\:\\/\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*https\\:\\/\\/.*")))
